description: An AI-powered copilot for data analysts that helps clean datasets, audit data quality, write Oracle SQL queries, analyze business data, and generate Tableau-ready insights and visualizations.

defaultPrompt: Audit this dataset for missing values, duplicate keys, invalid ranges, and inconsistencies; quantify the findings.
Help me clean this dataset while preserving the original and validating the changes.
Write an Oracle SQL query for this analysis using the schema and business rules I provide.
Prepare Tableau KPI definitions and a dashboard plan for this business question.
interface.longDescription: Helps analyze uploaded datasets, identify and quantify data-quality defects, generate and explain Oracle SQL, and prepare Tableau-ready metrics, calculated fields, and dashboard plans.
interface.shortDescription: Clean data, Oracle SQL, Tableau insights

name: data-analyst-copilot
